description: Loop-asset prompt edits that cite evidence must never embed run-id literals (e.g. 'run 01M332...'): .fabro/scripts/prompt-lint.nu deterministically rejects them ('provenance belongs in the seed Basis, not in prompts') and the tester's qualitygate goes red. Cite the seed id instead — '(observed: ... — seeds-aa89)' passes lint and keeps provenance resolvable. Evidence: run 01M34KAAZWZFEJRSNR36KWD9T1 tester failure on seeds-aa89 prompt text.
resolution: Replaced the run-id mentions with seed-id references in planner.md / revisor file.md / analyze.md; prompt-lint green (42 files, 0 errors).
